readme:
Hover States: Transition Timing: RESPONSIVE BEHAVIOR Breakpoint Strategy: Mobile Optimizations: BRAND ALIGNMENT PRINCIPLES Target Verticals: ✓ Creative technology companies ✓ Digital design agencies ✓ Tech startups and innovation labs ✓ Creative software platforms ✓ Digital entertainment services ✓ Modern tech consultancies Value Proposition: "Where technology meets artistry. Our gradient mesh interfaces create immersive digital experiences that blend cutting-edge aesthetics with functional clarity. Beauty through flowing color and light.".

**Blend:** Gradient Mesh 55% + Aurora Effects 25% + Glassmorphism 20%  
**Temperature:** 6/10 (warm) · **Formality:** 5/10 · **Tags:** creative, tech  
**Perfect for:** Creative Tech, Design Apps, Visual Platforms

## Content fundamentals

- Write for members and staff of the organization: direct, professional but warm.
- Headings name the thing plainly: “Innovation Metrics”, “Our Services”, “UI/UX Design”, “Brand Identity”.
- Buttons are short verb phrases in Title Case: “View Portfolio”, “Learn More”, “See Projects”, “Get Started”.
- Navigation uses single nouns: “Home”, “Services”, “Portfolio”, “Data”, “Contact”.
- The reference page uses emoji as inline glyphs (🎨 💎 ⚡ ©); keep them functional, never decorative.

## Color

- Set the page on `page-bg` with body text in `page-text`. The theme is dark.
- Identity colours: `page-surface`, `color-purple`, `color-blue`, `color-pink`. Lead with the first; use the rest for accents and emphasis.
- Status colours (`badge-success-bg`, `badge-warning-bg`, `badge-error-bg`, `badge-info-bg`) always travel with a word or icon; never signal state by hue alone.
- Each token's note says where the reference page uses it and, for text colours, its contrast on `page-bg`. Keep body text at 4.5:1 or better.

## Typography

- `display` — Sora, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
- `body` — "Plus Jakarta Sans", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif

Faces are hosted on Google Fonts (Sora, Plus Jakarta Sans); load them with:

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Sora:wght@400;600;700&family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600&display=swap">
```

- Set titles in `display` and running text in `body`.
- Uppercase is reserved for small labels (`label`), always with the letter-spacing given.

## Spacing, shape and elevation

- Spacing steps: `space-xs` 8px, `space-sm` 16px, `space-md` 24px, `space-lg` 32px, `space-xl` 48px, `space-2xl` 64px, `space-3xl` 96px, `space-4xl` 120px. Pad cards and sections from these steps only.
- Corners: `radius-8` 8px, `radius-12` 12px, `radius-20` 20px, `radius-24` 24px.
- Elevation: `shadow-glass`, `glow-aurora`, lowest first for resting cards, higher for hover and overlays.

- 3-WAY BLEND COMPOSITION

- Gradient Mesh (55%):
- ✓ Fluid color transitions across surfaces
- ✓ Multi-point gradient systems creating depth
- ✓ Dynamic color interpolation
- ✓ Smooth, organic gradient flows
- ✓ Mesh-based color distribution
- ✓ Layered gradient overlays
- ✓ Iridescent color shifting
- ✓ Radial and conic gradient combinations
- ✓ Soft gradient boundaries

- Aurora Effects (25%):
- ✓ Atmospheric lighting phenomena
- ✓ Northern lights inspired palettes
- ✓ Glowing, luminous edges
- ✓ Light diffusion effects
- ✓ Ethereal color blending
- ✓ Animated gradient hints
- ✓ Soft glow overlays
- ✓ Prismatic color splitting

- Glassmorphism (20%):
- ✓ Frosted glass backgrounds
- ✓ Backdrop blur effects
- ✓ Semi-transparent surfaces
- ✓ Layered depth perception
- ✓ Subtle shadow and glow
- ✓ Light refraction aesthetics
- ✓ Border luminosity
- ✓ Glass-like clarity

- BLEND CHEMISTRY - Ethereal Digital Beauty

- This design creates an immersive digital aesthetic where gradients aren't just
- backgrounds—they're the structural foundation. Every element exists in a flowing
- gradient mesh that creates natural depth and movement. Aurora effects add
- atmospheric beauty with glowing edges and ethereal transitions. Glassmorphism
- provides clarity and hierarchy through transparency and blur.

- The result is a design that feels both futuristic and organic, where colors
- flow naturally across the interface like liquid light. Users experience depth
- through layered transparencies and feel the ethereal beauty of aurora-inspired
- color transitions.

- COLOR PSYCHOLOGY & SEMANTICS

- Primary Gradient Palette - Flowing Transitions:
- Purple Base (#8B5CF6)         - Innovation, creativity, digital sophistication
- Blue Deep (#3B82F6)           - Trust, technology, stability
- Pink Accent (#EC4899)         - Energy, warmth, approachability
- Orange Glow (#F97316)         - Vitality, enthusiasm, action
- Cyan Aurora (#06B6D4)         - Freshness, clarity, modern tech
- Indigo Deep (#6366F1)         - Depth, professionalism, wisdom

- Glass & Transparency System:
- White Glass (rgba(255,255,255,0.1))  - Subtle surface definition
- Soft Glow (rgba(139,92,246,0.2))     - Aurora edge lighting
- Deep Shadow (rgba(0,0,0,0.2))        - Depth and separation
- Border Shimmer (rgba(255,255,255,0.3)) - Glass edge definition

- Gradient Formulas:
- Primary: linear-gradient(135deg, #8B5CF6 0%, #3B82F6 50%, #06B6D4 100%)
- Warm: linear-gradient(135deg, #EC4899 0%, #F97316 100%)
- Aurora: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(139,92,246,0.3), transparent 70%)
- Glass Surface: background rgba(255,255,255,0.1) + backdrop-blur(12px)

- Contrast Compliance:
- ✓ Text on glass surfaces: Enhanced with dark backgrounds ensuring 4.5:1+
- ✓ Interactive elements: Color + gradient + shadow for visibility
- ✓ Status indicators: High contrast colors on glass backgrounds
- ✓ Focus states: Multiple visual cues (outline + glow + scale)

- TYPOGRAPHY STRATEGY - Modern Digital Elegance

- Font Selection Philosophy:
1. Sora                      - Modern geometric with friendly curves, perfect for
- digital interfaces, excellent readability
2. Plus Jakarta Sans         - Humanist sans-serif with soft terminals, warm
- and approachable for body text
3. System fallbacks          - Performance and universal availability

- Size Scale - Flowing Hierarchy:
- H1: 48px / 3rem            - Hero titles with gradient text
- H2: 36px / 2.25rem         - Section headings
- H3: 24px / 1.5rem          - Card titles
- Body: 16px / 1rem          - Readable body text
- Small: 14px / 0.875rem     - Meta information
- Button: 16px / 1rem        - Clear interaction text

- Line Height - Breathing Space:
- Body text: 1.6             - Comfortable reading
- Headings: 1.2              - Tight, impactful
- Buttons: 1               - Compact, actionable

- Letter Spacing - Digital Precision:
- Headings: -0.02em          - Tight, modern aesthetic
- Body: 0.01em               - Slight opening for clarity
- Uppercase: 0.1em           - Strong spacing for labels

- Font Weights:
- Regular: 400               - Body text
- Medium: 500                - Subtle emphasis
- Semibold: 600              - Subheadings
- Bold: 700                  - Strong headings

- SPATIAL DENSITY - Flowing Layouts

- Grid Philosophy:
- Gradients create visual rhythm, so spacing emphasizes flow over rigid structure

- Container System:
- Max-width: 1400px          - Wide canvas for gradient expression
- Section padding: 120px     - Generous space for gradient transitions
- Card padding: 32px         - Room for glass effects to breathe
- Grid gaps: 24px            - Natural separation

- Glass Surface Spacing:
- Blur radius: 12px          - Soft frosted effect
- Border width: 1px          - Delicate glass edge
- Shadow depth: 0 8px 32px   - Floating elevation
- Glow spread: 0 0 20px      - Aurora edge effects

- COMPONENT ARCHITECTURE

1. GRADIENT MESH HEADER
- Multi-point gradient background
- Glassmorphism navigation bar
- Aurora glow on logo
- Smooth gradient transitions on hover
- Backdrop blur for depth

2. FLOWING METRICS DASHBOARD
- Glass card surfaces with gradient borders
- Large numbers with gradient text fills
- Aurora glow on stat changes
- Mesh gradient backgrounds
- Floating elevation effects

3. GRADIENT CONTENT CARDS
- Individual gradient meshes per card
- Glass overlay surfaces
- Aurora edge lighting
- Gradient icon backgrounds
- Smooth hover transformations

4. GLASSMORPHIC DATA TABLE
- Frosted glass table surface
- Gradient header background
- Aurora row hover effects
- Transparent borders with glow
- Mesh gradient behind table

5. GLASS FORM ELEMENTS
- Transparent input backgrounds
- Gradient focus states
- Aurora glow on active fields
- Glass button surfaces
- Flowing error/success states

6. GRADIENT BUTTON SYSTEM
- Primary: Full gradient mesh background
- Secondary: Glass with gradient border
- Tertiary: Gradient text only
- Aurora glow on hover
- Smooth gradient transitions

7. FLOWING STATUS BADGES
- Glass badge surfaces
- Gradient border glow
- Aurora color indicators
- Transparent backgrounds
- Gradient text fills

8. GRADIENT MESH FOOTER
- Large gradient background flow
- Glass content sections
- Aurora accents
- Transparent link surfaces
- Mesh gradient overlay

- ACCESSIBILITY COMPLIANCE - WCAG 2.1 LEVEL AA

- Visual Accessibility Strategies:
- ✓ Text contrast: Dark text on glass surfaces over dark backgrounds
- ✓ Focus indicators: Multi-modal (outline + glow + shadow + scale)
- ✓ Color independence: Never rely on gradient color alone
- ✓ Motion sensitivity: Respects prefers-reduced-motion
- ✓ Transparent overlays: Always ensure sufficient contrast

- Interactive Accessibility:
- ✓ Touch targets: 44px minimum on all interactive elements
- ✓ Keyboard navigation: Full support with visible focus states
- ✓ Screen readers: Semantic HTML + ARIA labels
- ✓ Focus management: Logical tab order throughout

- EMOTIONAL RESONANCE MAPPING

- Temperature: Creative Warm (6/10)
- Inviting gradient flows
- Ethereal aurora effects
- Approachable glassmorphism
- Futuristic yet friendly
- Innovation with warmth

- Formality: Balanced Professional (5/10)
- Modern tech aesthetic
- Creative but professional
- Digital sophistication
- Approachable design
- Innovation-focused

- Psychological Impact:
- ✓ Wonder: Aurora effects create atmospheric beauty
- ✓ Innovation: Gradient meshes signal cutting-edge tech
- ✓ Clarity: Glass surfaces provide visual hierarchy
- ✓ Depth: Layered transparencies create immersion
- ✓ Flow: Gradients guide eye movement naturally

## States and motion

- Hover States:
- Gradient shift and intensification
- Aurora glow expansion
- Glass surface brightening
- Subtle scale transformations
- Shadow depth increase

- Transition Timing:
- Fast: 0.2s - Micro-interactions
- Medium: 0.3s - Component states
- Slow: 0.5s - Gradient shifts
- Smooth: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)

- RESPONSIVE BEHAVIOR

- Breakpoint Strategy:
- Desktop (1024px+): Full gradient mesh complexity
- Tablet (768px-1023px): Simplified gradients
- Mobile (320px-767px): Reduced blur, simpler gradients

- Mobile Optimizations:
- Reduced backdrop blur for performance
- Simplified gradient stops
- Larger touch targets (56px)
- Single-column layouts
- Reduced glass effects for clarity

- BRAND ALIGNMENT PRINCIPLES

- Target Verticals:
- ✓ Creative technology companies
- ✓ Digital design agencies
- ✓ Tech startups and innovation labs
- ✓ Creative software platforms
- ✓ Digital entertainment services
- ✓ Modern tech consultancies

- Value Proposition:
- "Where technology meets artistry. Our gradient mesh interfaces create
- immersive digital experiences that blend cutting-edge aesthetics with
- functional clarity. Beauty through flowing color and light."

Timing values: `--transition-fast` 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), `--transition-base` 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), `--transition-slow` 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1).

- Honour `prefers-reduced-motion`: drop lifts and transitions to instant state changes.

## Iconography

- Inline SVG line icons on a 24×24 viewBox, 2px stroke, drawn in `currentColor` so they take the text colour around them.
- No logo ships with this style: set the organization name in the `display` style.

## Accessibility

- `page-text` on `page-bg` measures 8.1:1.
- Every interactive element shows a visible focus state at 3:1 or better against its surface.
- Measured on `page-bg`, these text colours fall short of 4.5:1: `color-pink` 4.3:1, `glass-white` 1.4:1, `glass-border` 2.6:1. Use them only for large text (24px+) or on the fills their notes name, whatever the design notes below claim.

## Not synced

Built from `style-169-gradient-mesh-ui.html`. No component bundle: the reference page's markup is not packaged as live components. Variables not representable as tokens (calc/clamp/gradients/font stacks): `--gradient-primary`, `--gradient-warm`, `--gradient-cool`, `--gradient-mesh`, `--gradient-aurora`, `--blur-glass`, `--blur-intense`.
